children: may retest support at $100.98 per barrel, a break below which could trigger a fall into the $98.74-$99.27 range.
A false break above the upper trendline of a wedge was confirmed as a top pattern by the deep fall during the previous trading session.
The fall also marked the reversal of an uptrend from $79.62. Four waves make up the trend. The bottom of wave (4) is around $88.74, which serves as one of the aggressive targets.
A realistic target is $98.74, the 500% projection level of the uptrend from $80.66. Resistance is at $102.88, a break above which may lead to a gain into $103.74-$104.59 range.
On the daily chart, the market repeatedly failed to break the $104.63-$107.01 resistance zone. The failures suggest the formation of a top.
Given the lack of a meaningful correction after the rise from $79.62 and the bearish divergence on the daily RSI, the market may retrace further, following Wednesday's drop.
